nodes.name: Build Unresolved Result
nodes.notes: No AGMARKNET query is made when the district cannot be resolved. The message names what was searched so the farmer can fix the farm record; substituting a nearby district would be worse than saying nothing.

nodes.name: Fetch AGMARKNET
nodes.notes: The data.gov.in key lives only in the n8n Query Auth credential (parameter name "api-key"). It is never in this JSON, never in .env, never in the repo. Filters are exact string matches on the resource field ids.

nodes.name: Map Market Result
nodes.notes: Prices pass through exactly as reported; a missing field becomes null, never 0. arrival_date is parsed from DD/MM/YYYY. An empty records array is "nothing matched", not success - this API returns HTTP 200 with status "ok" for zero rows.
